assessment.cache_identity: Explicit scopes bind selected content digests and missing states plus dependency pins; parent/module revision omitted for scoped objects. Whole-module scope includes immutable revision; unknown scope expands across all composition modules.
assessment.integrity: Composition/revision hashes and selected/dependency blob hashes checked; evidence and raw log digests checked. Idempotent replay compares full bound request and receipt request_key.
assessment.authorization: Host policy and callback are required. Exact True required for record/revoke; lookup rechecks runner record permission. Tenant partitions database operations. Host authenticates caller and tenant selection.
assessment.atomicity: Evidence and request receipt share BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction. Existing concurrent-idempotency and injected receipt-write failure tests pass.
assessment.claim_boundary: Returns cached_check_fact preserving original candidate and requested candidate. No automatic approval or production release claimed.

limits: This verifies a local trusted-host Python library and SQLite behavior, not an online HTTP/authentication integration.
Caller authentication, tenant selection, check-policy provenance, actual execution and complete read scope remain trusted-host obligations; this cache does not prove runner log truth.
No actual production checker was executed: fixtures provide runner logs and authorization callbacks.
Reopening the cache and per-operation SQLite connections verifies persistence here; separate process crash recovery and production stress capacity were not exercised.
Database administrators are trusted; hash checks detect tested corruption, not coordinated malicious database rewriting/deletion.
No token savings, model costs, production capacity, release approval, or completion of parent #1382 is established.
